_doctrine: 13-phase Wall Street cycle. Phase is JORDAN'S call (editorial). Until he calls it, phase='Awaiting Jordan's call' and phase_source='awaiting'. Score + trend are facts and always present; phase_suggestion is the auto/brain advisory. next_move is the FORWARD prediction (brain consensus) — where the phase goes next; current phase stays the anchor.

next_move.reasoning: Net exchange intake rising with suppressed CVD and soft 30d momentum under greedy F&G is classic distribution into Complacency, so the skilled lean is one rung down only.
next_move.brains_agree: Partial agree: both flag supply/intake risk; analyst explicitly calls Anxiety/DOWN low-conviction, narrative is silent on phase so no full lock
next_move.confirmed_if: BTC loses recent range, Fear & Greed slips under 55, exchange netflow stays elevated and CVD remains suppressed
next_move.invalidated_if: CVD turns neutral-positive, spot ETF flows reverse up, and BTC reclaims the 30-day high holding Complacency or lifting it
